item.title: Show HN: Pardonned.com – A searchable database of US Pardons
item.description:
📝 comInspired by the videos of Liz Oyer, I wanted to be able to verify her claims and just look up all the pardons more easily. Tech Stack: Playwright - to sccrape the DOJ website SQLite - local database Astro 6 - Build out a static website from the sqlite dbAll code is open source and available on Github.
🔗 Read more: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=47727960

item.title: France's government is ditching Windows for Linux, says US tech a strategic risk
item.description:
📝 France plans to replace Windows with Linux; EU open-source options include openSUSE. It has announced that it will shift away from proprietary technologies from outside the European Union and focus more on open-source solutions — and part of that means ditching Windows for Linux. So, where does this leave Linux.
🔗 Read more: https://www.xda-developers.com/frances-government-ditching-windows-for-linux/

item.title: ’Abhorrent’: the inside story of the Polymarket gamblers betting millions on war
item.description:
📝 They are betting on Ukraine. Polymarket users have bet on whether Russia will take the city. Critics have called this immoral; US senators have called for Polymarket to be regulated.
🔗 Read more: https://www.theguardian.com/business/2026/apr/11/polymarket-gamblers-betting-iran-war-ukraine-news-truth
